correctness.rationale: Moving-limit Taylor expansion of the exactly normalized Gaussian HS double integral gives cross-boundary Bessel I_n and self-boundary negative I_1 contributions. Differentiation of the disk potential fixes the normalization; all Fourier modes and quantifiers are specified. The Riccati equation for I_{n+1}/I_n proves strict hierarchy; standard small- and large-argument expansions give limits. Independent 4D quadrature and Bessel tests are reproduced in checks.py; numerical tests are corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Computes the natural exact quadratic invariant for the established disk maximizer of Gaussian Hilbert–Schmidt concentration. A full strict angular mode hierarchy, translation kernel, sharp elliptic direction and two area limits identify where error is least penalized. This is structurally useful local sensitivity information absent from qualitative global extremality, and not just a finite numerical fit.
